core.C2.statement: For a fixed process and origin debt: the non-increasing–strictly-decreasing–non-increasing payment macro-composite strictly decreases; the continuation relation is well-founded and irreflexive, and a zero budget admits no payment. Given a Noetherian master emit covering every same-debt current, each current constructs a finite GeneratedHistory, its exact target, a Settlement and a Receipt.

core.C10.statement: For a fixed SourceNativeLivingRootClosure: the canonical Process has a FaithfulRealization; every event of every faithful process recovers the canonical occurrence and all installed projections, with event = emitted; any two faithful realizations generate, through the common occurrence, a two-way representation compatible with the whole compilation; any candidate current-by-current event map equals the generated comparison pointwise.

core.C11.title: Master disposition, residual extension and causal audit
core.C11.statement: For a fixed living root, a complete complex Hilbert space H and an installed RecognitionAt: every step's master disposition selects exactly one of six cases; selecting RootedPassiveResidual generates a free residual coface on the same support and a causal-audit transfer: old rows stay identical, new rows gain authority, the occurrences at both ends are kept, and the whole ledger and next are recovered.

core.C12.title: Debt activation and event-by-event whole-ledger compilation
core.C12.statement: For every world N and DebtActivationLaw: the extended world has support base × Option DebtState; the inactive fibre recovers all old rows and the active fibre recovers the old rows plus a unique law-owned debt row. For a fixed lower root and current, OccurrenceIndexedSourceAt generates LedgerWriteEvolution, LedgerTerminalEvolution or a same-row U7 audit. In the target-6 instance, 2+4 → 3+3, the action-debt payment 1 → 0 and the target's terminal ledger are read separately.

core.C13.title: Minimal extension, unique factorization and the first write
core.C13.statement: For every RootedActualExpressibilityFailure: it generates the minimal whole-network coface; the old support, identity and ledger retract constructively, old facts and theorems are kept, and the new direction has no old preimage. Every AdmissibleCofaceRevisionAt has a unique FaithfulCofaceMorphism; the map of a typed revision sends the new direction to the new row of its first write; under field grounding the old and new rows obtain their answer and successor; capacity composition is associative.

core.C22.title: A responsibility born without a prior bearer, and its payment
core.C22.statement: For any old authoritative root, origin, and Raw Env/Expr reader on that origin's original occurrence: it generates a mathematical source, compiler, complete patch, reconstruction certificate and living process. The mathematical row is newly born from actual Steps and the old ledger is a same-source remainder; the budget is B − k, with a genuine payment for k < B and local settlement at k = B; the completed value is ev_ρ(e), and the relation image of the paid trace is e − const(ev e) ∈ ker.

core.C23.title: Whole-tree programs: execution, charging and independent read-back
core.C23.statement: For any Root, Carrier and any atOccurrence : Root → List Carrier → Carrier: the whole tree generates a program whose execution value is the native basis element of the fold; the budget is generated by the tree syntax β and the execution trace has length β; a syntax-only parser recovers the whole tree; when atOccurrence is constantly zero the program is still injective. core.C24.title: The actual action generates the next question
core.C24.statement: For any initial inquiry frame: the residual request e ⊖ e′ has value ev_ρ′(e) − ev_ρ′(e′) and old value 0, equal to the effect of the paid trace's relation certificate under the increment; r(e ⊖ e′) = r(e) + r(e′) + 2 > 0 and the first step is a responsibility admission; the recursive frames form every node of the existing inquiry runtime, erasure is injective and the query fibre is a singleton; only execution steps emit same-debt payment receipts.

core.C26.statement: For any old inquiry state, an installed Recognition at the same root and the original SourceNativeRootInquiryInputAt: both the full-generation and the joint-residual branches generate inputState/queryInput, the reader reads the original Query.raw directly, and the actual Math/Frame/Shared runtime arises from it; an independent consumer recovers the whole tree, the normal value and a paid Trace whose length equals the original tree budget; for every count the math whole and original material, and for every offset the query/answer/next, are kept; the remaining branches return the original Feed.

core.C27.title: The original successor supplies the next run
core.C27.statement: The only inputs are the original living root, an exact visit, a complete Recognition at the same root and the original U7/calculus: every continuing branch takes the original successor.next_eq to generate the next actual visit and rereads exposure/history; the next selected branch obtains a genuine source runtime or the exact Feed; the previous tick's complete packet/residual is kept as well; the two-tick whole ledger and canonical next are recovered by the same root; the new lower Source Inquiry/Frame receives only the source root, visit, calculus and raw reader.

core.C28.title: Complete time and the original action tree generated by one program
core.C28.statement: For any original root, complete temporal visit and installed Recognition: the Code of finite/sealed cofinal/post-cofinal material keeps the current and the whole history, encode/decode are mutually inverse, and Code.next recovers the original actual successor; the continuations of the two histories generate a common closure, two completion maps with the exact zero fibre, two evaluators and the original normed action; the Outcome of one ordered tree programme keeps the original effect, the complete temporal receipt tree and common/evaluator/action at once, and an independent parser recovers every node; the observation and image residuals of the target action difference give a genuine inverse criterion, and the original word and exposure tree are carried through the same occurrence to the literal next source.

core.C29.title: All actors, all words and all futures recovered into actual execution
core.C29.statement: All trace members of the original source and target trees generate actor actions and H read-outs; the kernel of the complete all-word Model equals the kernel of the joint readout of all words, and the whole carrier is generated by the original completion; each letter's E and point give an ordered effect history, and the total word residual is the sum of the step residuals transported by the subsequent E's; every trace position (repeated payloads included) generates node H/Gram; coarse × all future H, and the integral, cofinal and coarse faces, each have common kernel 0, with a genuine two-sided inverse on the actual image that keeps every word action; the paid AST and the same Trace are consumed.

core.C30.title: A paid query produces its next content, and the universal mother admission
core.C30.statement: The paid old value plus effect of the same actual query generates the born next content, and the original history(stage) is read out as history(stage+2) through the source action. For any original Frame, source-owned Programme and independent LowVar: the actual query's complete State/Trace, same-occurrence owner and next query environment produce by themselves a ResidualRequest, a firstStep with positive syntax budget and a debtAdmission at the same root and visit; the original whole first destination, all old projections, the literal next, the runtime current/next at every offset and no-refill/Noetherian are generated directly; the native shift and full packet of the same queryFrame return to the same mother admission.

core.C31.title: Typed inventory crosses the mother admission and is actually consumed again
core.C31.statement: For any original Frame, source-owned Programme and independent LowVar: the physical and low Raw, paid Result and complete Trace of the same supplied occurrence keep their original types; per-variable binding keeps every Expr/relation evaluation; eliminating the inherited typed outcome of the mother target yields the stock; the complete written record, the per-occurrence Fin coordinates and both the mathNext and nextBorn branches produce the next inventory query by themselves; the all-word cofinal, the original native packet and the complete reverse are consumed by the same actual query, whole and literal next.

core.C32.statement: The same original runtime/source produces by itself the ℤ-bilinear original-value pairing of formal operation words × complete sealed States; binding and sourceAction generate whole-carrier covariance, the canonical coimage action and iterates of any order; every prefix keeps its original AST execution, complete Trace and exposure; batches execute with payment at original coordinates, and callFrame/raw/query/receipt produce a finite snapshot by themselves that recovers the original iterated query and the complete epoch Past, consumed directly by the next request, whole and next.

core.C33.statement: The actual root/reader of the original Joint and Branch produces the initial frame and seed, and programme.reader directly executes the occurrenceRaw of the same supplied occurrence; the Shared actual query/input/answer/next are generated by the same seed/initial/count; the new paid exposure, the original inverse and Past pass to the next inventory; the core and relation ASTs of the Branch form a Fin 2 batch, and the source action, payment and complete substituted Trace enter the initial stock.

core.C34.statement: The same actual core produces by itself the Fresh.Complete old/next actor and the canonical packet; the Stage 0 seed event generates the original word and completion point; the original Plan and the actions of all exposure nodes generate the child AST, paid State and Trace; one typed main AST actually executes the original query together with the selected old/next child; a source-dependent decoder reads the original binding of the current environment and sends the complete child action to the true Born; the default live runtime consumes, stage by stage, the equations, inverse, payment, whole and next.

wla.WA1.title: Where does an actual difference enter the ledger?
wla.WA1.statement: For a fixed fully admitted authoritative root, if two lawful temporal visits differ, their exact registered occurrences must differ. For a fixed complete living process, the complete registered living currents of distinct states differ, including across a local terminal and the U8 handoff. This positive structure generates TotalReality, which in turn excludes instances of ExternalSupplement and MagicBit.

wla.WA2.title: Can inconvenient events be deleted and the case declared closed?
wla.WA2.statement: Every complete heterogeneous event-inventory admission keeps the two-way representation of ordinary current/event/evolution, branches and targets, whole-ledger write-back, finite patches, and cofinal event/emitter/path/landing. A represented terminal is recognised as the original actual terminal and consumes the independent exhaustiveness contract of the complete inventory. A two-event source in which an actual terminal and a write coexist cannot be represented two-way as a single-terminal event source.

wla.WA3.title: Can a receipt be lent to another source that looks the same?
wla.WA3.statement: Once the same source projection law and exact occurrence are fixed, two active witnesses certified by that classifier are equal and their complete dependent payloads are HEq; the inactive witness is unique as well. Two lawful installation paths read the same complete outcome for the same semantic component. Changing the source-fixed projection law yields a different complete source, and an old outcome type cannot be reused merely because the lower ledger is the same.

wla.WA4.title: Where do responsibilities missing from this tick's report go?
wla.WA4.statement: For every actual edge of a lawful lifecycle, a fresh slot has its original admission and a live disappearance has the original same-slot obligation terminal; release, transfer and supersession keep their corresponding live successors. For a complete root ledger row that has obtained authority, the same generatedLedgerAt generates the target entry and LedgerEntryEvolutionAt, or an exact terminal discharge; whether this tick's finite patch selects the row does not change whether a registered responsibility exists.

wla.WA5.title: Can splitting into several entries, or merging into one, launder responsibility?
wla.WA5.statement: Given a same-source reorganisation law and an actual ledger evolution, every repeated origin/destination must generate an identity or an actual split/merge classification; the receipt covers all corresponding child or parent rows and excludes phantom members. Every split child strictly debits the original parent's budget, so a zero-budget parent has no split authority.

wla.WA6.title: If two reports are identical, must the disposition be too?
wla.WA6.statement: For any observe/consumer, ConsumerSafe requires the consumer to be constant on every observation fibre; a given factorisation constructs safety. Any actual admission on an original state whose scope is invisible to the observation generates a HiddenNullWitness with the same observed value but different complete responsibility; further coarsening stays hidden, and it generates a FullTraceRedirect carrying the original event.

wla.WA7.title: When does moving an entry become an actual payment?
wla.WA7.statement: For a fixed living process and origin debt, an actual step lands in the original successor's whole ledger and keeps the same-debt target unique; same debt and no-refill are read from the actual row evolution. Any two no-refill finite histories with one strict payment between them compose to targetBudget < sourceBudget. The relation over all generated payment macro-steps is well-founded and cannot return to itself; this result takes no total closure law as input.

wla.WA8.title: How do reaching zero, local termination and final settlement relate?
wla.WA8.statement: Settlement requires both the original compiler's SourceFaithfulTerminalOccurrence and an empty same-lineage/claim fibre in the actual successor's whole ledger. Given a total emit law that generates a settlement or a paid macro for every exact same-debt current, following the actually emitted macro targets constructs a finite history, an exact endpoint and the original receipt. Conversely, if the budget is 0 and the original local terminal type is empty, the whole total closure law type is empty.

wla.WA9.title: After a change of language, can old debt still be found?
wla.WA9.statement: Given an exact same-root double-empty failure and a field-grounded typed revision, for every actually generated row of the revised initial patch the initial authority generates the target authority along the same first write, and the new living root generates the original answer-and-next. Old failure rows and new-only rows are each disposed of, and all initial rows share the same actual next.

wla.WA10.title: One actual action, payment and settlement, exhibited
wla.WA10.statement: On the fixed original target6 source, production compileDisposition generates an actual factor-two repair that turns 2+4 into 3+3; the same generated action is installed at the exact occurrence. The single step has no caller target field, the original budget goes strictly 1→0, the original support terminal is generated independently, and the same whole-ledger write enters the generic positive root; only then is a debt-inactive arithmetic next given.

wla.WA11.title: What independent content does the complete ledger generate positively?
wla.WA11.statement: Fixing the original unit compiler, the native-write branch extracts its actual transfer receipt and installs the block dependent face at the original target. The original stage-1 reading is non-zero, all later original history readings stay non-zero, the receipt aligns with the whole ledger at every tick, and the original transfer, whole ledger and literal next are unchanged. All finite repeated observations of the same whole integer class are zero while the first-stage integer reading is non-zero, which excludes any function that recovers this consumer for every original object from the whole family of observations.

wla.WA12.title: The original whole-ledger receipt generates the complete mathematical residual
wla.WA12.statement: Fixing the original raw-D compiler and eliminating the same actual native-write receipt, the complete source Law generates on that event a history/evaluator and four dispositions: faithful, unsound, kernel and coverage. The residual, differential and pairing are installed as dependent faces of the same source; the direct consumer reads the complete mathematical content, the original transfer row and the literal next together. The faithful branch generates an actual inverse map, and the coverage branch keeps, for any recovery function, a representative it cannot recover.

wla.WA13.title: Execution history writes its own relation receipt and pays
wla.WA13.statement: For any original Env/raw Expr, State keeps the paid past Trace starting from raw; every actual primitive generates a typed RelationIndex, and the boundary of Trace.relationWords is exactly single(raw) − single(pending). The original actual whole write, owner and math Step jointly generate a joint payer: every old destination/origin is kept by its original two-sided index, the old transferred receipt is embedded unchanged, and changes in the activation coordinates of old carried rows are paid by the same actual Step receipt. A new mathematical row strictly debits the budget, and its lineage is generated from the owner's actual destination. On the original Unit, any n-node budget becomes n − count after count ticks, the completed value recovers the original raw.eval from the paid Trace, and at remaining budget 0 the math State is kept and the original native next continues.

wla.WA14.title: The actual inquiry current consumes the same-debt payment and the complete physical difference
wla.WA14.statement: For any original Fock runtime and every post-birth depth, the original current of the actual inquiry node equals origin.advance(depth+1), its budget is 10 − (depth+1), and Trace.length + budget = 10. The same complete Type receipt of the canonical destination generates a unique same-debt target, a strict payment at positive budget and a ready law-free Noetherian continuation. wla.WA15.statement: The actual native/complete image of the original compiler is the input source, and the old IdentityScope is an existing certificate. The new inventory of rows.size + 1 keeps, by castSucc on each old row, all original indices, receipts and source/target selectors, with the new math row last; repeated claims or occurrences are not deduplicated. wla.WA16.statement: For any old authoritative root, the complete-native Program read by its actual compiler and the original registered input, oldObligation/readOld keep every admission, authority, assumption and discharge Type field in both directions. The mother's split/merge children and parents, ownership, anchor transport, lineage, local discharge, coverage, no-phantom and strict child debit lift unchanged; old and math rows are separated by their complete tags. wla.WA17.title: Whole-ledger join and remainder over every continuing branch
wla.WA17.statement: The original `Packet.read?` eliminates the actual generatedLedger and keeps the native, relation, continued-transport and redirect payloads, the whole evolution, the original patch and the actual next. For the per-current packet programme given by the source law, the same actual math action generates the whole join and the owner successor; one finite math row plus the complete transported remainder of the same source produces the patch, whose destination/origin complete Sigma is exactly the original join. The mother's original restructuring certificate lifts directly to this fold, keeping the old language, the theorem/realization fibres, the original observations of dynamic Type + Value and the whole projection family; the same living tick actually consumes it.

wla.WA18.statement: C22's public inputs are only the original root, origin and raw reader; the original fixed-support old ledger is kept whole by the source-generated remainder, and the actual Step newly births an independent math row. Its canonical destination generates a unique same-debt target and lineage; at positive budget it actually pays, with budget = B − count and completed Trace length = B; after local settlement there is no paid continuation and State does not refill the budget. The complete relation-receipt boundary raw − const(value) and the updated original inverse fibre are generated by the actually paid Trace.

wla.WA19.title: Original integer coefficients and substitution bodies enter the actual charge
wla.WA19.statement: For an original integer z and Expr e, the source expands repeated addition and the original negation: for z ≥ 0 the cost is z·(remaining(e)+1), and for z = −(n+1) it is (n+1)·(remaining(e)+1)+1. wla.WA20.statement: For any original root/origin/raw reader, the compiler's image consumes only its own actual action/rfl, and the same patch proves by itself that the math row is selected. `initialRow` generates the sealed initial authority from the canonical query, and the admissions at every count follow by recursion from the original whole-ledger `canonicalTargetEntryAtNext` and authority.next. wla.WA21.statement: C28's common/temporal/action tree executes only one original paired programme, and the Trace length strictly equals the original tree's syntactic budget; the full old/effect, original receipt, the two histories/evaluators and the original parent next are kept together. Any full-actor word executes the original action letter by letter: the Model's original programme costs n+2, the whole prefix plus later action costs n+3, and the ordered E/Model total programme cost is 2n+5; the actual paid total over each single step and the empty word is 7n+5. The complete old store and the query's actual exposure form the written store before the emitter, all original epoch Traces from 0 to depth enter the actual born through the source fold, and both ordinary and birth keep the inventory. literal-next executes the current syntax to self-produce nextTrace/nextWord, whose paid reverse complete old/effect strictly equals the original recover; the inverse Traces of every stage enter born together with the old pair. wla.WA23.statement: The original `nextEnvironmentRead = Some` only decodes the paid pair of the same query; the actual old + effect equals the output of the original History programme in the active environment, and the actual Shared.nextBorn installs this content directly. wla.WA24.statement: For any original Frame, source-owned Programme and its independent LowVar, the same-root/visit complete paid State/Trace/owner of the actual query and the increment of the literal next query self-produce the request and the first paid Step. wla.WA29.statement: On the same source-owned receiver/seed, the actual admission of the typed `nextSeed/nextCfg` keeps the old scalar/pair store, the written/outgoing store and every old projection; `Born.next_environment_source` generates the next environment from the same occurrence's `physicalNext`. `target_root`, `whole_first`, `canonical_next` and `next_reader` all come from the same `Admission.generatedAction`, so the born content, the inventory lineage and the canonical next are fields of one ledger event.

wla.WA30.title: The difference of two actual τ pays its own complete query account and keeps the original whole
